steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect circuit breaker or power cable before servicing electrical parts. Reconnect panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the circuit breaker or power cable before servicing.

steps.title: Inspect CN802 sub comms
steps.body: Check CN802 main-to-sub harness (pins 4–5 TX/RX, 1/3/9 5V/12V) and inverter CN903/CN904.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check CN802 main-to-sub harness (pins 4–5 TX/RX, 1/3/9 5V/12V) and inverter CN903/CN904.

steps.title: Comms stable in Service Inspection?
steps.body: AC: main↔sub fails 24 s (6 s in test mode). AC6: no inverter response 3 s ×3 then 2 min relay off.
steps.sourceExcerpt: AC: main↔sub fails 24 s (6 s in test mode). AC6: no inverter response 3 s ×3 then 2 min relay off.

steps.title: Replace sub-wire
steps.body: If AC persists after reseating CN802/CN101, replace sub-wire harness.
steps.sourceExcerpt: If AC persists after reseating CN802/CN101, replace sub-wire harness.

steps.title: Sub PBA and inverter seated?
steps.body: Reseat sub PBA and inverter PBA connectors. Check for corrosion or damaged pins.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reseat sub PBA and inverter PBA connectors. Check for corrosion or damaged pins.

steps.title: Replace sub or inverter PBA
steps.body: Replace failed sub PBA or inverter PBA.
steps.oemOutcome: Replace failed sub PBA or inverter PBA.

steps.title: Replace main PBA
steps.body: Replace main PBA when harness good but comms fail.
steps.oemOutcome: Replace main PBA when harness good but comms fail.
